narration.en: Every evening, someone seemed to stand behind his pantry door.
narration.zh: 每天傍晚，儲藏室門後好像都站著人。

narration.en: There were tiny bright holes in the head.
narration.zh: 那顆頭裡，有幾個細小亮點。

narration.en: Inside: empty shelves, and a hanger. No coat.
narration.zh: 裡面只有空架和衣架，沒有外套。

narration.en: He closed the door. The figure came back.
narration.zh: 他關上門。人影又回來了。

narration.en: Then he looked at what stood in front of the glass.
narration.zh: 接著，他看向玻璃前方的東西。

narration.en: He lifted the colander. The head moved away from the shoulders.
narration.zh: 他拿起濾盆，頭就離開了肩膀。

narration.en: The lamp had joined two ordinary shadows into one visitor.
narration.zh: 燈光把兩個普通影子，拼成了一位訪客。
